about: kv_task Amendment 1 (reports/plans/2026-10-23_plan_kv-task-amend1.md): the Pile harness on E10's saved Adam 1e-5 component-training states rand32 and ident32 at steps 10, 100, 300 (and rand32 @30, the control), no new training. Filed before any run

gates.C1_control: shard 0, first state: rand32 @30's PGD ratio within 25% of E10's 2.81, so it reads 'fail' again. Fails: the shard stops and shard 1 is not launched
gates.G0_w0: first in each shard: faith_score.w0_check (seed-0 PGD within 10% of 0.69, CI-masked within 2% of 0.348, PGD floor <= 0.25). Fails: the shard stops
gates.G1_states_are_E10s: each state's held-out P and KL elsewhere within 0.01 of E10's curve at its step, size within 1%. Fails: the shard stops

measurement.blind_to: the trained behaviour (the marker never occurs in Pile); damage a 20-step adversary does not find (it is far from converged, reports/reviews/2026-10-22_review_vpd-adversary-convergence.md); one adversary seed per state, one batch order
measurement.damage_elsewhere: held-out KL of the target model against W0 at every position but the key, nats, absolute; 0 at W0
measurement.pile: harness.measure: Pile val rows 0..255, two 128-row blocks, one 20-step PGD adversary per block (seed 0), stochastic; each a ratio to this shard's W0 under seed 0 (relative). At W0: 1 (absolute PGD 0.69, CI-masked 0.348)
measurement.size: max over the 24 matrices of ||dW|| / ||W0||, absolute; 0 at W0
measurement.verdict: faith_score.state_verdict with p_min 0 (the step-10 states have not learned; the verdict reads the decomposition, not the task): stochastic and PGD ratios each against W0's own floor f (max/min - 1 over adversary seeds 0, 1, 2 in the shard; PGD 0.209 on the L40): pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f) (PGD about 1.24 and 1.81), inconclusive between; any fail -> fail, any inconclusive -> inconclusive

outcome.content: 32 new associations fail where the identity control passes; size not exactly matched (0.020 vs 0.015) and E21's low-rate Adam passed rand32 at 0.0146: read as content x size, next the pair-count sweep through /design
outcome.mixed: reported per state; more adversary seeds on the split states before any reading
outcome.rule: from P1 and P2's four late states: ident32 both pass and rand32 both pass -> 'step'; ident32 both pass and rand32 both fail -> 'content'; all four fail -> 'size'; anything else -> 'mixed'
outcome.size: the identity control fails at rand32 @30's size with little damage, and rand32 fails too: the cipher result is a size result
outcome.step: E10's failure belonged to its scored step (its damage elsewhere), not to the size (to 0.021) or to 32 new associations: the Q4 card closes, no pair-count sweep

predictions.predicted: pass, least sure (sizes 0.020, 0.021 exceed every Adam pass so far, max 0.018 in E21)
predictions.why: E21: Adam component training failed only while its damage elsewhere was >= 0.2 nats; rand32's falls to 0.021 and 0.012 by these steps
sizes 0.014, 0.015 match rand32 @30's 0.0154 with damage 0.015, 0.011; ident32 @30 passed at 1.19 (E10, E21)

predictions.rule: rand32 @10 and ident32 @10 both read 'fail' or 'inconclusive'
predictions.why: both carry damage 0.22-0.24 at size 0.007; E21's Adam states with damage >= 0.2 read fail or inconclusive. First out-of-sample test of E21's after-the-fact damage cut (0.147)
